record.question: Which one of the following is not one of the main objectives of IATA Ledger?
options: Identify employment generation in tourism industries and the role tourism plays in job creation for different types of workers
Evaluate the performance of each travel agency which is recognized by IATA.
Determination of total commission earned by the travel agency.
Identification of travel agencies' revenue sources.
record.explanation: The IATA Ledger objectives cover agency performance, commission and revenue sources; employment generation is not one of its objectives, so option A is the exception.

paper.title: COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF TOURIST OFFICER UNDER TOURISM DEPARTMENT, GOVERNMENT OF MIZORAM, DECEMBER- 2020. TECHNICAL PAPER-I
